'''Defensive Shields''' may refer to:
* [[Defensive Shield]], the card type introduced in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] (2001)
* [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]], the Players Committee's December 2006 sheet of 18 virtual Defensive Shield slips
* [[Virtual Shields]], the Players Committee's list of Legacy-era (2009&ndash;2014) virtual Defensive Shields, called Virtual Block D on its card lists
* [[Virtual Set D]], the current Players Committee Defensive Shields set
